caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden figure of a man standing on an irregularly shaped green and yellow pedestal. The man has dark skin and curly black hair, and he wears a dark green hat with a brim. His attire consists of a blue jacket with red sleeves, a green vest with a blue necktie, a white collared shirt, tan knee-length pants, and dark shoes. The figure is shown in a lively pose: his left hand is placed on his hip, and his right forearm is raised with his hand touching his forehead. His mouth is open, revealing white teeth, as if he is smiling or laughing. The background is a plain beige color, and the artist's signature "MINA LOWRY" appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Figure of a Black Man
